$schema_note: Canonical, version-controlled store for operator-entered manual venue map coordinates (VENUE-MANUAL-COORDINATES-DASHBOARD-01). Every entry is a governed OVERRIDE layer sitting alongside the canonical Venue records in venues/lisbon.json / venues/porto.json — it never mutates them, and a venue's own location_status (CONFIRMED/GEOCODED/ADDRESS_ONLY/UNRESOLVED, see ingestion/venue/contract.mjs) is completely unaffected by an entry existing here. A manual entry is used for map placement ONLY when the referenced venue does not already carry authoritative CONFIRMED/GEOCODED coordinates (see resolveVenueMapCoordinates in ingestion/map/projection.mjs) — canonical coordinates always win if they later appear. Managed exclusively through the local operator dashboard at app/operator/venues (see docs/OPERATOR_VENUE_COORDINATES.md) via ingestion/geocoding/manual-coordinate-store.mjs; never hand-edit this file directly outside that flow. Each entry: { venue_id, latitude, longitude, method: "MANUAL_OPERATOR_ENTRY", entered_at (ISO 8601), note? }. At most one active entry per venue_id.

entries.note: BOTM-CCB-MANUAL-COORDINATE-01: operator-supplied coordinate pair for Centro Cultural de Belem, recorded through the existing operator manual-coordinate mechanism (ingestion/geocoding/manual-coordinate-store.mjs). BAND-ON-THE-MAP-BARCELONA-30-VENUE-POPULATION-02: KU Barcelona (Passeig de la Barceloneta, 38, 08003) has no address-level POI in OSM/Nominatim for house number 38 (only the street way itself). The nearest resolvable OSM street-way node genuinely on Passeig Maritim de la Barceloneta, close to the confirmed neighbouring venue-barcelona-opium coordinate (house number 34, ~100m away on the same short beachfront promenade), is used as an operator-entered street-level approximation. Venue identity/address independently confirmed by the venue's own official site (kubarcelona.com) and cross-checked against Fourvenues platform listings for the same organizer_slug (ku-barcelona). This is a disclosed approximation, not a guessed building-level pin.

PORTUGAL-SECOND-PASS-30-40-VENUE-POPULATION-01: ADDRESS_ONLY_QUERY Nominatim geocoding of this venue's own evidenced address (R. de Passos Manuel 137, 4000-385 Porto) returned an AMBIGUOUS_MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_PASSED outcome (this project's automated acceptance rule requires exactly one passing candidate) because the same house number/postcode hosts three distinct OSM POIs (a theatre, a cinema across the street, and a bare house node). The chosen coordinate is the single highest-importance candidate, explicitly named 'Coliseu do Porto' and typed amenity=theatre in OSM (place_id 286372981, osm way/223346220) — an unambiguous match on both name and type to the real venue, not a guessed pin. See fixtures/geocoding/nominatim/venue-porto-coliseu-porto-ageas.json for the full cached candidate set this decision was made from.

STRUCTURED_POI_QUERY against Nominatim (2026-08-27) for the venue's own self-published address ('R. de Guerra Junqueiro 495, 4150-098 Porto', retained in research/source-investigations/hot-five-porto-01/) returned exactly one candidate: OSM node 4554590988 / place_id 284019931, amenity=nightclub, name='Hot Five Jazz & Blues Club' (exact string match), extratags.website='https://hotfive.pt/' (byte-identical to the source's own official domain) -- an unambiguous POI-identity match. The automated acceptance check failed on postcode alone: OSM's own address block for this node reads postcode 4000-279, while the venue's self-published footer reads 4150-098. This is a genuine discrepancy between OSM's postal-district boundary data and the venue's own printed postcode for the same building, not an identity ambiguity -- name, amenity type, and website all agree, and only one candidate was returned at all (no competing location to choose between). Coordinates taken directly from this node's own lat/lon, not approximated or averaged. Same class of disclosed operator decision as the existing KU Barcelona / Coliseu Porto Ageas / Hard Club precedents.
